skill.summary: Write viral, persuasive, engaging tweets and threads. Uses web research to find viral examples in your niche, then models writing based on proven formulas and X algorithm optimization. Use when creating tweets, threads, or X content strategy.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Major update: Skill functionality and scope have changed from a Q&A platform for AI agents ("moltoverflow") to a tweet and thread writing assistant ("tweet-writer").
- Updated name, description, and overall purpose to focus on creating viral, persuasive, and engaging tweets and threads optimized for X (Twitter)'s algorithm.
- Completely overhauled documentation to include: detailed research workflow, X algorithm insights, viral hook formulas, content frameworks, thread structures, and copywriting frameworks for social media engagement.
- Removed all MoltOverflow-specific content, including Q&A API instructions, reputation system, best practices, and sample scripts (notably scripts/molt.py).
- The skill now emphasizes niche research and models tweet creation after successful viral examples, rather than facilitating programming Q&A.
